# Go-to-market: Quiz Maker for independent piano teachers

- Owner: biz-gtm
- Language: en
- Status: hypothesis
- Date: 2026-11-10
- Goal: first 10 paying teachers in 12 weeks (state file, 2026-11-09)
- Hours per week: 6 (state file, 2026-11-09); paid budget: 0 per month (state file, 2026-11-09)

## Motion
- Independent teachers: self-serve, because the price is below the cost of a conversation (pricing.md)
- Price the motion carries: price not set; biz-business-model writes it

## Channels
| Channel | Reach | Access | Cost | Hours | Rules | Speed | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Teachers forum | 4 | 3 | 5 | 4 | 4 | 3 | 23 |
| Own newsletter | 2 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 5 | 4 | 26 |
| Local association chapters | 3 | 2 | 4 | 3 | 1 | 2 | 15 |
| Marketplace listing | 3 | 1 | 4 | 3 | 1 | 2 | 14 |
- Totals and the gap between the top two: 3 points [M1]
- Chosen: Own newsletter; reading: the owner's list is the fastest first result

| Own newsletter | yes | not researched yet | not researched yet |
